name: SKINCOS | 01 Inbound Triagem (Evolution -> Postgres)

parameters.query:
with input as (
    select
        nullif('{{$node["02_Parse_Evolution"].json.message_id}}', '')::text as message_id,
        nullif('{{$node["02_Parse_Evolution"].json.message_text_sql}}', '')::text as message_text,
        nullif('{{$node["02_Parse_Evolution"].json.message_type}}', '')::text as message_type,
        nullif('{{$node["02_Parse_Evolution"].json.phone_e164}}', '')::text as phone_e164,
        nullif('{{$node["02_Parse_Evolution"].json.phone_raw}}', '')::text as phone_raw,
        nullif('{{$node["02_Parse_Evolution"].json.push_name_sql}}', '')::text as push_name,
        nullif('{{$node["02_Parse_Evolution"].json.unit_slug}}', '')::text as unit_slug,
        nullif('{{$node["02_Parse_Evolution"].json.raw_payload_sql}}', '')::text as raw_payload,
        now() as ts
),
existing as (
    select id from wa_n8n.processed_message_ids p
    join input i on p.provider_message_id = i.message_id
    limit 1
),
log_received as (
    insert into wa_n8n.events (event_type, payload, created_at)
    select 'message_received', jsonb_build_object(
        'message_id', i.message_id,
        'phone_e164', i.phone_e164,
        'text', i.message_text,
        'unit_slug', i.unit_slug
    ), i.ts
    from input i
    returning id
),
ins_processed as (
    insert into wa_n8n.processed_message_ids (provider, provider_message_id, received_at, processed_at, created_at)
    select 'evolution', i.message_id, i.ts, i.ts, i.ts
    from input i
    where i.message_id is not null and not exists (select 1 from existing)
    returning id
),
contact as (
    insert into wa_n8n.contacts (phone_e164, phone_raw, push_name, created_at, updated_at)
    select i.phone_e164, i.phone_raw, i.push_name, i.ts, i.ts
    from input i
    where i.phone_e164 is not null and exists (select 1 from ins_processed)
    on conflict (phone_e164) do update set
        phone_raw = coalesce(excluded.phone_raw, wa_n8n.contacts.phone_raw),
        push_name = coalesce(excluded.push_name, wa_n8n.contacts.push_name),
        updated_at = now()
    returning *, (xmax = 0) as inserted
),
log_lead_created as (
    insert into wa_n8n.events (event_type, contact_id, payload, created_at)
    select 'lead_created', c.id, jsonb_build_object('phone_e164', c.phone_e164), now()
    from contact c
    where c.inserted is true
    returning id
),
log_lead_updated as (
    insert into wa_n8n.events (event_type, contact_id, payload, created_at)
    select 'lead_updated', c.id, jsonb_build_object('phone_e164', c.phone_e164), now()
    from contact c
    where c.inserted is false
    returning id
),
conversation as (
    insert into wa_n8n.conversations (contact_id, unit_slug, last_message_at, last_inbound_at, created_at, updated_at)
    select c.id, i.unit_slug, i.ts, i.ts, i.ts, i.ts
    from contact c, input i
    on conflict (contact_id, unit_slug) do update set
        last_message_at = excluded.last_message_at,
        last_inbound_at = excluded.last_inbound_at,
        followup_stage = 0,
        updated_at = now()
    returning *, (xmax = 0) as inserted
),
message as (
    insert into wa_n8n.messages (conversation_id, direction, provider_message_id, message_type, text, raw_payload, created_at)
    select conv.id, 'inbound', i.message_id, i.message_type, i.message_text,
           case when i.raw_payload is not null then i.raw_payload::jsonb else null end,
           i.ts
    from conversation conv, input i
    returning id
),
log_duplicate as (
    insert into wa_n8n.events (event_type, payload, created_at)
    select 'message_ignored_duplicate', jsonb_build_object('message_id', i.message_id), i.ts
    from input i
    where exists (select 1 from existing)
    returning id
)
select
    (select count(*) from existing) > 0 as is_duplicate,
    (select id from contact limit 1) as contact_id,
    (select inserted from contact limit 1) as contact_created,
    (select id from conversation limit 1) as conversation_id,
    (select funnel_status from conversation limit 1) as funnel_status,
    (select triage_step from conversation limit 1) as triage_step,
    (select triage_data from conversation limit 1) as triage_data,
    (select needs_human from conversation limit 1) as needs_human,
    (select do_not_contact from contact limit 1) as do_not_contact
;

insert into wa_n8n.events (event_type, contact_id, conversation_id, payload, created_at)
values (
  'opt_out',
  '{{$node["03_DB_Init"].json.contact_id}}'::uuid,
  '{{$node["03_DB_Init"].json.conversation_id}}'::uuid,
  jsonb_build_object('message', '{{$node["02_Parse_Evolution"].json.message_text_sql}}'),
  now()
);

insert into wa_n8n.consent (contact_id, do_not_contact, reason, source, created_at, updated_at)
values (
  '{{$node["03_DB_Init"].json.contact_id}}'::uuid,
  true,
  'opt_out_keyword',
  'whatsapp',
  now(),
  now()
);

with appt as (
  select id, conversation_id
  from wa_n8n.appointments
  where conversation_id = '{{$node["03_DB_Init"].json.conversation_id}}'::uuid
  order by created_at desc
  limit 1
),
log as (
  insert into wa_n8n.events (event_type, contact_id, conversation_id, payload, created_at)
  select
    case when {{$node["02_Parse_Evolution"].json.confirm_yes}} then 'appointment_confirmed' else 'appointment_cancelled' end,
    '{{$node["03_DB_Init"].json.contact_id}}'::uuid,
    appt.conversation_id,
    jsonb_build_object('appointment_id', appt.id),
    now()
  from appt
  returning id
)
update wa_n8n.appointments
set status = case when {{$node["02_Parse_Evolution"].json.confirm_yes}} then 'confirmado' else 'cancelado' end,
    updated_at = now()
where id = (select id from appt);

insert into wa_n8n.events (event_type, contact_id, conversation_id, payload, created_at)
values (
  'status_changed',
  '{{$node["03_DB_Init"].json.contact_id}}'::uuid,
  '{{$node["03_DB_Init"].json.conversation_id}}'::uuid,
  jsonb_build_object('status', case when {{$node["02_Parse_Evolution"].json.confirm_yes}} then 'confirmado' else 'reagendar' end),
  now()
);

update wa_n8n.conversations
set funnel_status = case when {{$node["02_Parse_Evolution"].json.confirm_yes}} then 'confirmado' else 'reagendar' end,
    updated_at = now()
where id = '{{$node["03_DB_Init"].json.conversation_id}}'::uuid;

select e.payload->'slots' as slots
from wa_n8n.events e
where e.event_type = 'appointment_slots_proposed'
  and e.conversation_id = '{{$node["03_DB_Init"].json.conversation_id}}'::uuid
order by e.created_at desc
limit 1;

insert into wa_n8n.events (event_type, contact_id, conversation_id, payload, created_at)
values (
  'handoff_requested',
  '{{$node["03_DB_Init"].json.contact_id}}'::uuid,
  '{{$node["03_DB_Init"].json.conversation_id}}'::uuid,
  jsonb_build_object('reason', '{{$node["20_Decide_Triage"].json.handoff_reason_sql}}'),
  now()
);

insert into wa_n8n.events (event_type, contact_id, conversation_id, payload, created_at)
values (
  'handoff_triggered',
  '{{$node["03_DB_Init"].json.contact_id}}'::uuid,
  '{{$node["03_DB_Init"].json.conversation_id}}'::uuid,
  jsonb_build_object('reason', '{{$node["20_Decide_Triage"].json.handoff_reason_sql}}'),
  now()
);

with current as (
  select id, funnel_status
  from wa_n8n.conversations
  where id = '{{$node["03_DB_Init"].json.conversation_id}}'::uuid
  limit 1
),
log as (
  insert into wa_n8n.events (event_type, contact_id, conversation_id, payload, created_at)
  select 'status_changed',
    '{{$node["03_DB_Init"].json.contact_id}}'::uuid,
    current.id,
    jsonb_build_object('status', case when current.funnel_status = 'novo_lead' then 'em_triagem' else current.funnel_status end),
    now()
  from current
  returning id
)
update wa_n8n.conversations
set needs_human = true,
    funnel_status = case when funnel_status = 'novo_lead' then 'em_triagem' else funnel_status end,
    updated_at = now()
where id = '{{$node["03_DB_Init"].json.conversation_id}}'::uuid;

insert into wa_n8n.events (event_type, contact_id, conversation_id, payload, created_at)
select 'triage_completed',
  '{{$node["03_DB_Init"].json.contact_id}}'::uuid,
  '{{$node["03_DB_Init"].json.conversation_id}}'::uuid,
  jsonb_build_object('triage_step', {{$node["20_Decide_Triage"].json.next_step}}),
  now()
where '{{$node["20_Decide_Triage"].json.next_action}}' = 'schedule';

insert into wa_n8n.events (event_type, contact_id, conversation_id, payload, created_at)
select 'status_changed',
  '{{$node["03_DB_Init"].json.contact_id}}'::uuid,
  '{{$node["03_DB_Init"].json.conversation_id}}'::uuid,
  jsonb_build_object('status', 'qualificado'),
  now()
where '{{$node["20_Decide_Triage"].json.next_action}}' = 'schedule';

update wa_n8n.conversations
set funnel_status = case when '{{$node["20_Decide_Triage"].json.next_action}}' = 'schedule' then 'qualificado' else funnel_status end,
    triage_step = {{$node["20_Decide_Triage"].json.next_step}},
    triage_data = '{{$node["20_Decide_Triage"].json.triage_data_sql}}'::jsonb,
    updated_at = now()
where id = '{{$node["03_DB_Init"].json.conversation_id}}'::uuid;

insert into wa_n8n.events (event_type, contact_id, conversation_id, payload, created_at)
values (
  '{{$node["20_Decide_Triage"].json.triage_event || "triage_answered"}}',
  '{{$node["03_DB_Init"].json.contact_id}}'::uuid,
  '{{$node["03_DB_Init"].json.conversation_id}}'::uuid,
  jsonb_build_object('triage_step', {{$node["20_Decide_Triage"].json.next_step}}),
  now()
);

insert into wa_n8n.events (event_type, contact_id, conversation_id, payload, created_at)
values (
  'status_changed',
  '{{$node["03_DB_Init"].json.contact_id}}'::uuid,
  '{{$node["03_DB_Init"].json.conversation_id}}'::uuid,
  jsonb_build_object('status', '{{$node["20_Decide_Triage"].json.new_status}}'),
  now()
);

update wa_n8n.conversations
set funnel_status = '{{$node["20_Decide_Triage"].json.new_status}}',
    triage_step = {{$node["20_Decide_Triage"].json.next_step}},
    triage_data = '{{$node["20_Decide_Triage"].json.triage_data_sql}}'::jsonb,
    last_outbound_at = now(),
    updated_at = now()
where id = '{{$node["03_DB_Init"].json.conversation_id}}'::uuid;

insert into wa_n8n.events (event_type, contact_id, conversation_id, payload, created_at)
values (
  'outbound_message_queued',
  '{{$node["03_DB_Init"].json.contact_id}}'::uuid,
  '{{$node["03_DB_Init"].json.conversation_id}}'::uuid,
  jsonb_build_object('text', '{{$node["20_Decide_Triage"].json.reply_text_sql}}'),
  now()
);
